source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U26: Apply response clocks,reasoned refusal and partial access

payload.title: Track the request clock and explain the decision
payload.core_explanation_md:
The ordinary described response limit is thirty days; a life-or-liberty request has the stated forty-eight-hour rule. Special routes, fee-intimation exclusion and applicable receipt events require their own calculation rather than assuming every request uses one unqualified deadline. Failure to decide in time is deemed refusal, not a grant of unlimited permission to disclose anything.

A rejection communicates reasons, the appeal period and appellate particulars. Where exempt and non-exempt parts can be separated, the severance route requires a reasoned partial-access notice. The requested form is the starting point, subject to the stated disproportionate-resource and preservation qualifications. Do not use resource diversion as an unexplained blanket substitute for the statutory exemption analysis.

self_check.prompt_text: What should a refusal communicate besides the result?
self_check.expected_takeaway: Reasons and the relevant appeal information.

payload.stem_md: A PIO rejects a request with only the word rejected and no reasons or appeal details. Which requirement is missing?

options.explanation_md: It is not the substantive requirement.

options.text_md: The reasoned refusal and appellate information
options.explanation_md: The applicant needs the statutory decision information.

options.text_md: A promise to disclose all customer data
An invitation to pay an unofficial fee
options.explanation_md: That is not a lawful response requirement.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The applicant needs the statutory decision information.

payload.stem_md: A record contains both disclosable and exempt material. The officer assumes the presence of any exempt line always requires withholding the whole record. What must be considered?

options.text_md: No decision until the applicant withdraws
options.explanation_md: That does not meet the framework.

options.text_md: The applicable severance and reasoned partial-access procedure
options.explanation_md: The non-exempt portion needs separate consideration.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The non-exempt portion needs separate consideration.
